description: One cold launch per process of a kernel whose loop body is body_ops straight-line dependent FMAs, executed loops times by a loop that is not unrolled; one kernel per body size. Entry is: query the selected kernel's attributes to request that the runtime load it without running it (whether that fully pre-loads it is runtime-specific; any loading it leaves undone falls inside the timed launch), optional clock/cache warmer, then the single timed launch, which is the kernel's first dispatch in the process. From times at several body_ops and loops, derive downstream the fixed dispatch cost, the repeat-pass cost per FMA (time difference between two loops values divided by the extra FMAs: the incremental time per FMA including the loop overhead of the extra passes; it rises when the body no longer fits an instruction-cache level) and the first-pass extra (a residual of the one-pass time relative to that estimated baseline, in which what bringing the code in costs the first time shows), against the measured code bytes of each compiled kernel. A change of loop-close layout between body sizes (short versus long branch, visible in the compiled code) is a confound when comparing sizes. The body's own execution time hides any refetch faster than the body consumes code. The differences do not separate instruction fetch from address translation.

scaling_param.name: body_ops
scaling_param.description: FMAs in the straight-line loop body; selects the kernel fetch_kernel_<body_ops> and with it the static code footprint

non_scaling_params.name: loops
non_scaling_params.description: Times the loop body is executed in the one timed launch; FMAs per thread = body_ops * loops, at most 1048576. 1 runs every FMA once, on code not executed before; larger values add repeat passes over the same code

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid; the declared sweep uses one block so a single SM/CU fetches the code

non_scaling_params.name: threads_per_block
non_scaling_params.description: Number of threads per block; the declared value is one AMD wavefront

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: When true, run the clock/cache warmer before the timed launch. It does not promise a particular cache or clock state.
